welcome.title: LivePlay
welcome.subtitle: Audio cue playback for live events
welcome.modeSubtitle: Where should LivePlay run the audio engine?
welcome.localModeDescription: Run the audio engine on this computer.
welcome.remoteModeDescription: Connect to a LivePlay server on the network.
welcome.remoteAddressHint: Enter the IP address or hostname of the LivePlay server.
welcome.connectionFailed: Could not connect to the server
welcome.serverUnreachable: Found the server, but could not connect. Check that its firewall allows TCP port 4480.
welcome.connectedLocal: Using the local server on this computer
welcome.noServersFound: No servers found yet. Make sure a server is running on this network.
welcome.localServerFailed: The local server could not start
welcome.localServerFailedWithError: The local server could not start: {error}

settings.title: Settings
settings.ltcOutputHelp: The output that carries LTC timecode for this show. Map outputs to hardware under Hardware Outputs.
settings.ltcOutputUnavailableHelp: “{name}” is not available on this server, so no timecode is sent. Map it under Hardware Outputs, or choose another output.
settings.outputTargetHelp: The loudness standard for this show. It sets the limiter ceiling, meter and waveform colours, and the Auto-adjust volume target.
settings.meterModeHelp: The scale used on all meters.
settings.meterBallisticsHelp: How fast the meters rise and fall.
settings.disableAutoVolumeAndTrim: Don't auto-level volume or trim silence when importing
settings.disableLimiterHelp: Lets peaks go above the output ceiling. Safe to change during a show.
settings.disableSilenceWarningHelp: Hides the "Silence in" countdown in the header.
settings.transitionModeHelp: How newly imported tracks hand over to the next one. You can change it per track in Properties.
settings.autoCueNext: Always set the next item as Up Next
settings.autoCueNextHelp: Marks the next item as Up Next even when the playing item has no end behaviour, so one GO button steps through the playlist. Nothing starts on its own.
settings.stopAllFadeHelp: How long everything takes to fade out when you press Stop All. 0 stops instantly.
settings.scrollToPlayingHelp: Keeps the playing item centred in the playlist.
settings.indexDisplayStartHelp: The number shown for the first playlist item. API index paths always start at 0.
settings.routingInMixer: Routing is set in the mixer: each cue plays through a bus, and each bus goes to an output or another bus.
settings.sectionPlaybackHelp: How cues start, end and hand over to each other. Saved with the show.
settings.sectionAudioHelp: Loudness standard, limiter, meters and timecode for this show.
settings.sectionMixerHelp: How the mixer is laid out on this screen. Saved on this computer only, not in the show or your account.
settings.mixerViewHelp: Choosing a docked view opens the mixer if it is closed. The buttons on the mixer panel also change this.
settings.mixerViewNoWindow: A separate window requires the desktop app. In a browser, the mixer can be docked or fill the workspace.
settings.sectionKeyboardHelp: Shortcuts for playback and cart slots. Click a row, then press the keys you want.
settings.sectionSurfacesHelp: Control LivePlay from a MIDI controller. Click Learn next to an action, then move a fader, knob or button.
settings.sectionProjectHelp: Saving and cue numbering for this project.
settings.autosaveHelp: Saves after every change. When off, use File › Save; the header shows when there are unsaved changes.
settings.sectionServerHelp: The server this app is connected to and, for administrators, its configuration.
settings.sectionUsersHelp: Who can use this server and what they can change.
settings.stopAllStopsPreview: Stop All also stops the preview
settings.stopAllStopsPreviewHelp: When off, Stop All does not stop a cue you are previewing.
settings.sectionAppearanceHelp: How LivePlay looks for you. Not saved in the show.
settings.languageHelp: Only changes this screen. Others connected to the show keep their own language.
settings.themeModeHelp: Dark is the default and suits a dimly lit control room.
settings.themeModeSystemNow: Currently {mode}. Changes automatically with the system setting, even during a show.
settings.accentColorHelp: Used for selections, playing cues and highlights.

playlist.importHint: Drag audio files here, or use Import Audio

cart.title: Cart Player
cart.emptySlot: Click to import, or drag an item here
cart.clickToImport: Click to import, or drag an item here
cart.groupSlot: Playlist group: plays the whole group from this slot

properties.title: Properties
properties.peakWarning: This item is much louder than the Output Target level. Use Auto-adjust volume to correct it, or change the Output Target.
properties.noSelection: Select an item to view properties
properties.busNone: No buses yet. Add one in the mixer.
properties.busHelp: The bus this cue plays through. The bus's output, level and processing are set in the mixer.
properties.busGroupHelp: The bus this group's cues play through, unless a cue sets its own.
properties.ltcOutputTimecodeHelp: Sends timecode to the LTC output while this cue plays.
properties.ltcRequiresOutput: Choose an LTC output in Settings › Audio & Metering to enable timecode.
properties.multiSelectWaveform: Multiple items selected. Select a single item to show its waveform.
properties.volumeDbInput: Type a level in dB, e.g. -6.5 (or -inf for silence)
properties.manualStopFadeHint: How long this cue fades out when you press Stop. 0 stops it instantly.
properties.loopCrossfadeHint: Crossfades the end of the loop into its start over this many seconds. 0 loops without a crossfade.
properties.loopCrossfadeNeedsLoop: Set this cue's end behaviour to Loop to use a loop crossfade.
properties.advanceDelayHint: After this cue ends, wait this long before its end behaviour starts the next cue. Ignored when a crossfade or Start Next is set.

playback.startNextCountdown: Time until the next track starts

actions.cueToContinue: Cue to Continue: finish this loop, then advance
actions.jumpCue: Jump Cue: stop now and advance immediately
actions.previewNoBus: The Preview bus has no output. Set one in the mixer.

login.title: Sign In
login.message: Sign in to the LivePlay server at {url}.
login.setupMessage: This server has no accounts yet. The first one you create is an administrator, and from then on everyone needs to sign in.
login.name: User name
login.setupNote: At least {min} characters. Keep it safe: if it is lost, the only way back in is to delete users.json on the server machine.
login.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords do not match.
login.hint: No account? Ask whoever set up this server.
login.setupHint: Until an account exists, anyone who can reach this server can run the show.

connectionLost.title: Connection Lost
connectionLost.message: Lost connection to the LivePlay server at {url}.
connectionLost.locked: Controls are locked until the connection is back. Audio on the server keeps playing.
connectionLost.reconnectHint: Retry Now tries again straight away.
connectionLost.restartHint: Restart relaunches the client. The audio server keeps running.

sessionRecovery.title: Server Restarted
sessionRecovery.message: Reconnected, but the server has no project open (it was probably restarted). Your project is still on this computer.
sessionRecovery.resumeHint: Continue Session reopens the project on the server.
sessionRecovery.startFreshHint: Start Fresh closes it and returns to the welcome screen.

serverSettings.localModeDesc: LivePlay runs its own audio engine on this computer. Best for solo operators.

serverSettings.engineNotRunning: Local server not running. Click Apply to start it.
serverSettings.externalHint: Using an external server. Make sure the remote URL is reachable.

serverConfig.title: Server configuration
serverConfig.intro: Settings for this server. They are not saved with the show.
serverConfig.adminOnly: Only an administrator can view or change the server configuration.
serverConfig.unavailable: Could not load the server configuration.
serverConfig.locked: The server configuration is locked. It can only be changed on the server machine.
serverConfig.overriddenHelp: changes made here apply once that override is removed
serverConfig.restartRequired: Saved. Restart the server to apply: {keys}.
serverConfig.meterRateHelp: How often the meters on this screen update. Lower it for a tablet on Wi-Fi; peaks are still caught.

users.authOff: Login is off. Anyone who can reach this server can run the show.
users.authOffHelp: Creating the first account turns login on for every client of this server. That account becomes an administrator.
users.authOffExplicit: This server has accounts, but login is off. Anyone who can reach this server can run the show.
users.authOnNow: Login is on. Every client must sign in before it can run the show.
users.authTurnOffHelp: Accounts are kept, so you can turn login back on without recreating them.
users.authTurnOnConfirm: Every client of this server, including this one, will need to sign in.
users.authTurnOffConfirm: Anyone who can reach this server will be able to run the show without a password.
users.authKeepsAccounts: No accounts are deleted. Confirm with an administrator password.
users.authTurnedOff: Login is now off. Accounts have been kept.
users.authChangeFailed: Could not change the login setting.
users.firstIsAdmin: The first account is always an administrator.
users.authNowOn: Created {name}. Login is now on for this server.
users.adminOnly: Only an administrator can view or change accounts.
users.name: Name
users.addFailed: The account could not be created.
users.removeHelp: Their preferences are deleted and they are signed out everywhere at once. API tokens they issued keep working until you revoke them.
users.removeFailed: The account could not be removed.
users.passwordRevokes: Changing a password signs that person out on every device.
users.passwordChangedSelf: Password changed. You have been signed out everywhere, including here.
users.saveFailed: The change could not be saved.
users.signOutEverywhereHelp: Signs you out on every device, including this one.
users.signOutEverywhereConfirm: Sign out of every device, including this one?

accountFile.title: Export and import accounts
accountFile.help: Save all accounts and API tokens to a file, or load them from one. Useful for moving your team to another LivePlay server.
accountFile.warning: The file contains password hashes. Keep it somewhere safe and delete it when you no longer need it.
accountFile.exportFailed: The accounts could not be exported.
accountFile.previewCounts: Accounts in this file: {users}. API tokens: {tokens}.
accountFile.mergeHelp: Adds accounts and API tokens from the file. Existing accounts with the same name are left unchanged.
accountFile.replaceHelp: Removes every account and API token on this server and puts the ones from the file in their place.
accountFile.replaceConfirm: Remove all current accounts and API tokens and replace them with the ones in the file? This cannot be undone.
accountFile.resultMerge: Accounts added: {added}. Already here and skipped: {skipped}. API tokens added: {tokens}.
accountFile.resultReplace: Accounts replaced. Accounts on this server: {count}.
accountFile.signedOut: Your account was changed by the import. Please sign in again.
accountFile.notAFile: That file could not be read as a LivePlay account file.
accountFile.importFailed: The accounts could not be imported.
accountFile.firstImport: Moving from another LivePlay server? Import its accounts instead.

apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.help: Let other software control LivePlay, such as Companion, a show-control system or a script.
apiTokens.scope: A token can run the show and open and save projects. It cannot browse the server's files, manage accounts or change server settings.
apiTokens.nameHelp: Name it after what will use it, so you can identify it later.
apiTokens.passwordWhy: Tokens do not expire, so confirm with your password.
apiTokens.shownOnce: Copy it now. It will not be shown again.
apiTokens.renameHelp: The name is only for your reference. Renaming does not change the token.
apiTokens.revokeHelp: Whatever is using this token stops working immediately.
apiTokens.dormant: API tokens on this server: {count}. They are not checked while login is off, and will work again when it is turned back on.
apiTokens.issueFailed: The token could not be issued.
apiTokens.revokeFailed: The token could not be revoked.

mixer.title: Mixer
mixer.empty: All cues route to Master. Add a bus to split your mix.
mixer.panHint: Places this mono bus between left and right. Constant power: -3 dB at centre.
mixer.balanceHint: Left/right balance. Turns one side down; at centre both stay at full level.
mixer.widthHint: Stereo width: 0 is mono, 1 is unchanged, 2 is extra wide. Wider settings can make the bus louder.
mixer.bassMonoHint: Bass mono: makes everything below this frequency mono. Off when turned fully down.
mixer.correlationHint: Phase correlation. +1 is mono-safe, 0 is wide, below 0 means parts will cancel in mono.
mixer.shapeHint: Bell or shelf. A bell boosts or cuts around its frequency; a shelf boosts or cuts everything beyond its corner.
mixer.qHint: How wide the bell is. Higher is narrower.
mixer.slopeHint: Shelf steepness. 1 is the steepest setting without overshoot at the corner.
mixer.eqHandleHint: Drag for frequency and gain, wheel for Q, shift for fine, double-click to reset.
mixer.monoCheckHint: Listen in mono on the Preview output. PFL a bus first; anything that cancels in mono drops out. The main output is not affected.
mixer.busRouteUnbound: This bus's routing doesn't reach an output, so it is silent.
mixer.outputNoneHelp: This bus has no direct output. It is heard only through its aux sends.
mixer.outputNoneSilent: This bus has no output and no sends that reach one, so it is silent.
mixer.noStrip: No meter available for this bus
mixer.pflHint: Pre-fade listen: hear this bus on the Preview bus, before its fader and mute. The main output is unaffected.
mixer.outputUnmapped: "{name}" is not set up in Hardware Outputs. If a device with that name is connected it will be used; otherwise this bus is silent.
mixer.unboundTitle: Some cues have nowhere to play
mixer.unboundBody: These buses go to outputs that are not available on this server, so their cues will be silent: {buses}. Remap the outputs or reroute the buses.
mixer.outputMapIntro: The outputs this project's buses use, and the hardware device and channel each one is mapped to on this server.
mixer.outputMapDeleteConfirmBody: These buses use this output and will be left without hardware:
mixer.outputMapAdminOnly: Only an administrator can change hardware outputs.
mixer.sendTapPreHelp: Pre-fader: the send ignores this bus's fader and mute. Click for post-fader.
mixer.sendTapPostHelp: Post-fader: the send follows this bus's fader and mute. Click for pre-fader.
mixer.filterParked: Off. Turn the knob to bring the filter in; double-click it to take the filter out again.
mixer.bypassHint: Bypass this section. Its settings are kept for when you switch it back on.
mixer.gateToggle: Turn the expander/gate on or off, independently of the section bypass.
mixer.compToggle: Turn the compressor/limiter on or off, independently of the section bypass.
mixer.setMasterHint: Make this the Master bus: cues without a bus play through it, and it feeds the main output.
mixer.setPreviewHint: Make this the Preview bus: PFL and cue previews play through it.
mixer.roleDeleteBlocked: This is the {role} bus. Give that role to another bus before deleting it.
mixer.previewUnmapped: The Preview bus has no output, so PFL and cue previews are silent. Choose an output for it.
mixer.previewHint: PFL and cue previews play through this bus. Its fader sets your headphone level.
mixer.outputMapBuiltin: Built-in output. Map it, or leave it on the default device.

remap.intro: Drag an output from the right onto a missing one, or click one and then the other. Nothing changes until you save. Applies to this server only, not the show file.
remap.allConnected: Every output this show uses is connected.
remap.kindUnknown: Not set up on this server
remap.pickAvailable: Now pick an output on the right
remap.pickSlot: Now pick a missing output on the left
remap.noDevices: No audio outputs found on this server.
remap.advancedHint: Edit every output channel by channel

feeding.inheritedDefault: Plays here by default (no bus set on the cue or its groups)
feeding.partial: {n} of the {total} cues in this group feed this bus

eq.analyserHint: Show the live spectrum behind the EQ curve: post-EQ, or pre and post (dashed line = pre-EQ)
eq.graphHint: Double-click to add a band. Drag to move, scroll to change width, and Alt-click, right-click or press Delete to remove.
eq.empty: No EQ bands. Double-click to add one.
eq.handleHint: Drag to move · scroll for width · Alt-click or right-click to remove

mixer.miniMixerHint: Show a mini mixer below the bus settings

proc.openHint: Open this bus's EQ and dynamics
proc.limHint: The hardware output this bus feeds has a brickwall limiter

limiter.title: Limiter
limiter.hint: The brickwall limiter on this bus's hardware output. It catches peaks from everything on that output.
limiter.grHint: How much the limiter is reducing the output right now
limiter.settingsHint: Turn the limiter on or off in Settings › Audio & Metering. The ceiling comes from the Output Target.

migration.title: This project was made in an earlier version of LivePlay and has been updated.
migration.itemsToMain: Its {count} cues now play through the Master bus.
migration.busesFromOverrides: {count} cues that had their own output device now play through new buses for those devices.
migration.mainOutput: Its output device is now the Master bus output.
migration.previewDevice: Its preview device is now the Preview bus output.
migration.ltcDevice: Its timecode device is now the LTC output in Settings › Audio & Metering.
migration.roles: The Master and Preview buses were set up automatically.
migration.sendsDropped: {count} sends to buses that no longer exist were removed.

group.containsLoop: Contains a looping cue, so the time shown excludes the loop

workspace.hideWindow: {pane} is in a separate window. Click to bring it back here, collapsed.
workspace.emptyHint: Click or drag a bar at the edge, or use the buttons at the top, to open a pane.
